title: Nine Winters and One Short Note
subtitle: 挫折振作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 挫折振作（人与自我·做人与做事）
meta: 主题语境：挫折振作（人与自我·做人与做事）　|　核心词汇：failure　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 failure 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my father ① met a failure that no clerk in the office would have named, and he said the meeting was the whole of the winter. The ② failure, meaning the defeat itself and not the mistake, ran nine winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a failure, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ failure in that office had the same short note beside it, and the ④ failure at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the ledger and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A failure, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my father said the naming is the part that fills nine winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the failure was the whole of the machine, meaning the breakdown and not the defeat. The ⑥ failure, meaning the breakdown and not any of that, is the only thing in a machine that everybody waits for and nobody names; failure, he said, is either something you meet or the only word that means both a defeat and a breakdown. He said the breakdown is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ failure had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ failure of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one office and nine winters of naming; failure, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ failure I remember is the one named in the report, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ failure, my mother said in 1978, is the only one that improves by being named; every failure, she said, is a breakdown that has agreed to look like a defeat. She said the breakdown was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 失败（指办公室里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 失败（指那一次本身，与失误相对）
C. 固定搭配：meet a failure 遭遇一次失败
D. n. 失败（指留给账簿的那一次）
E. n. 失败（抽象总称，指一间办公室的失败之事）
F. n. 失败（指报告上写到、被说出的那一次）
G. n. 故障；失灵（指一台机器里人人都等却无人说出的那样东西）
H. n. 故障（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说出的那样东西）

items.q: met a failure that no clerk in the office would have named
The failure, meaning the defeat itself and not the mistake
the failure at the far side
the failure was the whole of the machine
the failure had become a line in a report
The failure of the whole thing
A failure, my mother said in 1978

answers.why: meet a failure 意为“遭遇一次失败”，1966 年父亲遭遇了一次办公室里没有一位办事员肯说出的失败。
failure 意为“失败”，指那一次本身而不是失误，它经过了九个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
failure 意为“失败”，指办公室里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一张短短的字条。
failure 意为“失败”，指留给账簿的那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
failure 意为“故障、失灵”，指一台机器里人人都等却无人说出的那样东西，叔叔说这次故障就是那台机器的全部。
failure 意为“故障”，指人人都等却无人说出的那样东西而不是那一次失败，是机器里人人都等、却无人说出的东西。
failure 意为“失败”，指报告上写到、被说出的那一次，到 1973 年这一次成了报告里的一行。
failure 意为“失败”，父亲一月写道，整件事的失败之事是一间办公室和九个冬天的说出。
failure 意为“失败”，我记得的是报告上说出的那一次，1976 年结束了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一次。
failure 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，一次失败是唯一会因为被好好说出而变得更好的东西。
